_comment: M5-3 / M5-5 / M6-1 (research/M5-no-boss-nights.md §6): nights with no boss, decided by the players, for every player. Applied to event/common.emevd.dcx by scripts/build-gamedata.ps1 (after emevd-bots.json in the dev package). night_end 1 / 2: once the night is on (7515, the clock at 23:59) the host's game waits for our flag 10007400 (the DLL sets it when one team is left standing, features/night_match.rs; dev console night_end) or secs (a fallback so a night can never hang), then sets that night's done flag 7502 / 7507 network-wide (8020 too when the special event is on); the game's own morning follows (flasks, grace, Day 2 at 07:00). Per-game events: 10007410 heals the local player (only the night's winner: the DLL sets it in the winner's game), 10007411 / 10007412 play the match ending in that game (win banner 4000 then 7000 / failure banner 4010 then 7001). replace: 1180 (the vanilla wipe check: everyone down at night = game over for all) and 1302 (vanilla 'boss arena' SpEffect 102120, which holds a knocked player's bleed-out at 15 s at night inside the circle) get empty bodies. features/night_match.rs and features/nights.rs use the same ids (unit tests check this file). One entry per line.
